import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

-- One legal blackboard move.
def BlackboardMove
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ),
    1 < m ∧
    1 < n ∧
    s = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest ∧
    t =
      Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ
      (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ
      rest

-- The board t can be obtained from s after zero or more moves.
def Reachable
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen BlackboardMove s t

-- No further legal move can be made from s.
def Terminal
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t

-- There is no infinite sequence of legal moves starting from s.
def TerminatesFrom
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s

lemma prod_move (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧
      t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod ∧
      t.prod ≤ s.prod ∧
      (0 < s.prod → (t.prod = s.prod ↔ Nat.gcd m n = 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hge1 : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := hgcdpos
  refine ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : t.prod * 1 ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := mul_le_mul_left' hge1 t.prod
    rw [mul_one] at hle
    calc t.prod ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := hle
      _ = s.prod := heq
  · intro hspos
    constructor
    · intro htst
      have h1 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
        have h0 := heq
        rw [htst] at h0
        exact h0
      have h2 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod * 1 := by rw [mul_one]; exact h1
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hspos h2
    · intro hg
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq

noncomputable def Cnt (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ := (s.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card

lemma cnt_cons_pos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = 1 + Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_pos (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h, Multiset.card_cons]
  omega

lemma cnt_cons_nonpos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : ¬ 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_neg (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h]

lemma cnt_cons_le (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) ≤ 1 + Cnt s := by
  by_cases h : 1 < a
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos s h]
  · rw [cnt_cons_nonpos s h]
    omega

lemma count_move_le (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Cnt t ≤ Cnt s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  subst hs
  subst ht
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have h1 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ rest)
  have h2 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) rest
  have ht_le : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) ≤ 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
    omega
  omega

lemma count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ)
    (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1) :
    Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) =
      Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) - 1 := by
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
    have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rw [hcop, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh
  have hmn : 1 < m * n := by
    nlinarith
  have ht_eq : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) = 1 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [hcop, hlcm]
    simp only [Nat.div_one]
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos (a := 1) (m * n ::ₘ rest) (by decide), cnt_cons_pos rest hmn]
  omega

noncomputable def Mu (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ := (s.prod, Cnt s)

def LtLex (p q : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := p.1 < q.1 ∨ (p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2 < q.2)

lemma move_decreases_measure (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) (hpos : 0 < s.prod) :
    LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := by
  show t.prod < s.prod ∨ (t.prod = s.prod ∧ Cnt t < Cnt s)
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  by_cases hg : Nat.gcd m n = 1
  · right
    have hst : t.prod = s.prod := by
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq
    refine ⟨hst, ?_⟩
    have hcnt := count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime rest m n hm hn hg
    rw [← ht] at hcnt
    have hCs : Cnt s = Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by rw [hs]
    have hpos2 : 0 < Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by
      rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm]
      omega
    rw [hCs, hcnt]
    omega
  · left
    have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
    have hgt1 : 1 < Nat.gcd m n := by omega
    have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
      · exfalso
        rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
        omega
      · exact h0
    have hlt : t.prod < t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgt1 htpos
      simpa using h2
    rw [heq] at hlt
    exact hlt

lemma lt_lex_wf : WellFounded LtLex := by
  have H : ∀ a : ℕ, ∀ b : ℕ, Acc LtLex (a, b) := by
    intro a
    have Ha : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) a := wellFounded_lt.apply a
    induction Ha with
    | intro a _ ih =>
      intro b
      have Hb : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) b := wellFounded_lt.apply b
      induction Hb with
      | intro b _ ihb =>
        apply Acc.intro
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := q
        have hq' : c < a ∨ (c = a ∧ d < b) := hq
        rcases hq' with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact ih c h1 d
        · rw [h1]
          exact ihb d h2
  exact ⟨fun p => H p.1 p.2⟩

lemma acc_pos_prod :
    ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, 0 < s.prod → Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
  have key : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, Mu s = p → 0 < s.prod →
      Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
    intro p
    have hacc : Acc LtLex p := lt_lex_wf.apply p
    induction hacc with
    | intro p _ ih =>
      intro s hMu hpos
      apply Acc.intro
      intro t ht
      have hlt : LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := move_decreases_measure s t ht hpos
      rw [hMu] at hlt
      have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
        obtain ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, hle, hiff⟩ := prod_move s t ht
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
          omega
        · exact h0
      exact ih (Mu t) hlt t rfl htpos
  intro s hpos
  exact key (Mu s) s rfl hpos

lemma exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two (t : Multiset ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ Cnt t) :
    ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ), 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧ t = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest := by

  have hu3 : t = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ (r' + u) := by
    rw [hu2, Multiset.cons_add]

  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hp, hq⟩ := h

    1 ≤ Cnt t := by

lemma nat_dvd_sub {k m n : ℕ} (h1 : k ∣ m) (h2 : k ∣ n) : k ∣ m - n := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2
  rcases le_total y x with hxy | hxy
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Nat.le.dest hxy  -- hz : y + z = x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    have hm : m = n + k * z := by
      rw [hx, hy, ← hz]
      ring
    omega
  · have hmn : m ≤ n := by
      rw [hx, hy]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hxy
    rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hmn]
    exact dvd_zero k

lemma gcd_min_max_sub (a b : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd a b = Nat.gcd (min a b) (max a b - min a b) := by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd a (b - a) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h2 h1
    have d2 : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a (b - a)
        have hb : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ a + (b - a) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at hb
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2
  · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd b (a - b) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h1 h2
    have d2 : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right b (a - b)
        have ha : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ b + (a - b) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at ha
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2

lemma factorization_gcd_eq_min (p m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hm' hn']
  simp [Finsupp.inf_apply]

lemma pow_dvd_of_not_dvd_of_dvd_mul {p a b k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) (hdvd : p ^ k ∣ a * b) : p ^ k ∣ b := by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime p a := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).mpr hpa
  have hcop' : Nat.Coprime (p ^ k) a := hcop.pow_left k
  exact hcop'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd

lemma factorization_mul_eq_add (p a b : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    (a * b).factorization p = a.factorization p + b.factorization p := by
  have ha' : a ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hb' : b ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_mul ha' hb']
  simp [Finsupp.add_apply]

lemma factorization_complement_min_zero (p m n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ m' n' : ℕ,
      m = Nat.gcd m n * m' ∧
      n = Nat.gcd m n * n' ∧
      m'.factorization p = m.factorization p - (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p ∧
      n'.factorization p = n.factorization p - (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p ∧
      min (m'.factorization p) (n'.factorization p) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_right m n
  have hgpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.gcd m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    · omega
  have hm'pos : 1 ≤ m' := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m' with h0 | h0
    · exfalso; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hm'; omega
    · omega
  have hn'pos : 1 ≤ n' := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n' with h0 | h0
    · exfalso; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hn'; omega
    · omega
  have hmul_m : m.factorization p = (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + m'.factorization p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hm']
    exact factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) m' hp hgpos hm'pos
  have hmul_n : n.factorization p = (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + n'.factorization p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hn']
    exact factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) n' hp hgpos hn'pos
  have hgmin : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n hm hn
  refine ⟨m', n', hm', hn', by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  rcases le_total (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) with hle | hle
  · have hgeq : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = m.factorization p := by
      rw [hgmin, min_eq_left hle]
    have hm'0 : m'.factorization p = 0 := by omega
    rw [hm'0]
    exact min_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _)
  · have hgeq : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = n.factorization p := by
      rw [hgmin, min_eq_right hle]
    have hn'0 : n'.factorization p = 0 := by omega
    rw [hn'0]
    exact min_eq_right (Nat.zero_le _)

noncomputable def Gp (p : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.gcd (s.map (fun x => x.factorization p))

lemma multiset_gcd_cons_nat (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Multiset.gcd (a ::ₘ s) = Nat.gcd a (Multiset.gcd s) := by
  rw [Multiset.gcd_cons]
  rfl

lemma Gp_eq_cons_cons (p : ℕ) (m n : ℕ) (rest : Multiset ℕ) :
    Gp p (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) =
      Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (Nat.gcd (n.factorization p) (Gp p rest)) := by
  unfold Gp
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons]
  rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat, multiset_gcd_cons_nat]

lemma factorization_lcm_eq_max (p m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p = max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_lcm hm' hn']
  simp [Finsupp.sup_apply]

lemma factorization_move_complement (p m n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p =
      max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
  have hmn : m * n ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hlcmpos : 1 ≤ Nat.lcm m n := by
    have hgl := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.lcm m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hgl
      exact hmn hgl.symm
    · omega
  have hhpos : 1 ≤ Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hcalc
      omega
    · omega
  have hfact : (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p =
      (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p := by
    have hstep := factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) hp hgcdpos hhpos
    rwa [hcalc] at hstep
  have hgc : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  have hlcm : (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p = max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_lcm_eq_max p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

lemma Gp_move_eq (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hst : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Gp p t = Gp p s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := hst
  subst hs
  subst ht
  rw [Gp_eq_cons_cons, Gp_eq_cons_cons]
  set R := Gp p rest with hR
  have hgc : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  have hgd : (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p =
      max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_move_complement p m n hp hm hn
  rw [hgc, hgd]
  calc
    Nat.gcd (min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))
        (Nat.gcd (max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)
            - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)) R)
        = Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd (min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))
            (max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)
              - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))) R :=
          (Nat.gcd_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)) R := by
          rw [← gcd_min_max_sub]
    _ = Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (Nat.gcd (n.factorization p) R) :=
          Nat.gcd_assoc _ _ _

lemma gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero : ∀ {u : Multiset ℕ}, (∀ y ∈ u, y = 0) → Multiset.gcd u = 0 := by
  intro u
  refine Multiset.induction_on u ?_ ?_
  · intro h; simp
  · intro a s ih h
    have ha : a = 0 := h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
    have hs : ∀ y ∈ s, y = 0 := fun y hy => h y (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy)
    rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat, ha, ih hs, Nat.gcd_zero_left]

lemma factorization_le_one_eq_zero {p x : ℕ} (h : x ≤ 1) : x.factorization p = 0 := by
  interval_cases x <;> simp [Nat.factorization_zero, Nat.factorization_one]

lemma Gp_eq_zero_of_forall_le_one {u : Multiset ℕ} (p : ℕ) (h : ∀ x ∈ u, x ≤ 1) :
    Gp p u = 0 := by
  unfold Gp
  apply gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
  rw [← hxy]
  exact factorization_le_one_eq_zero (h x hx)

lemma Gp_eq_val_of_singleton_filter {t : Multiset ℕ} (p : ℕ) {M : ℕ}
    (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    Gp p t = M.factorization p := by
  have hsplit : t = t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) + t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x) :=
    (Multiset.filter_add_not (fun x => 1 < x) t).symm
  have hrest : ∀ x ∈ t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x), x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx2 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    omega
  have hGprest : Gp p (t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x)) = 0 :=
    Gp_eq_zero_of_forall_le_one p hrest
  have ht_eq : t = M ::ₘ t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    rw [hM]
    simp
  rw [ht_eq]
  unfold Gp
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons]
  rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat]
  unfold Gp at hGprest
  rw [hGprest, Nat.gcd_zero_right]

lemma Gp_reachable_eq (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hst : Reachable s t) :
    Gp p t = Gp p s := by
  induction hst with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail h1 h2 ih =>
    rw [Gp_move_eq p hp h2, ih]

lemma factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ}
    (hst : Reachable s t) (hterm : Terminal t) {M : ℕ}
    (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    M.factorization p = Gp p s := by
  have hGpt : Gp p t = M.factorization p := Gp_eq_val_of_singleton_filter p hM
  have hGeq : Gp p t = Gp p s := Gp_reachable_eq p hp hst
  rw [← hGpt]
  exact hGeq

lemma eq_of_factorization_eq_all {a b : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → a.factorization p = b.factorization p) : a = b := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq (by omega) (by omega)
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p.Prime
  · exact h p hp
  · rw [(Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff a p).mpr (Or.inl hp),
        (Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff b p).mpr (Or.inl hp)]

lemma unique_M_eq {s t1 t2 : Multiset ℕ}
    (h1 : Reachable s t1) (hterm1 : Terminal t1)
    {M1 : ℕ} (hM1 : t1.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M1})
    (h2 : Reachable s t2) (hterm2 : Terminal t2)
    {M2 : ℕ} (hM2 : t2.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M2}) :
    M1 = M2 := by
  have hM1mem : M1 ∈ t1.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM1]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M1
  have hM1gt : 1 < M1 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hM1mem).2
  have hM2mem : M2 ∈ t2.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM2]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M2
  have hM2gt : 1 < M2 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hM2mem).2
  apply eq_of_factorization_eq_all (by omega) (by omega)
  intro p hp
  have e1 : M1.factorization p = Gp p s :=
    factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp h1 hterm1 hM1
  have e2 : M2.factorization p = Gp p s :=
    factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp h2 hterm2 hM2
  rw [e1, e2]

lemma exists_terminal_reachable : ∀ {s : Multiset ℕ}, Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s →
    ∃ t, Reachable s t ∧ Terminal t := by
  intro s h
  induction h with

    by_cases hex : ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
      obtain ⟨t', ht'1, ht'2⟩ := ih t ht
      exact ⟨t', Relation.ReflTransGen.head ht ht'1, ht'2⟩
    · exact ⟨s, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hex⟩

lemma cnt_terminal_eq_one {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hs : 1 ≤ Cnt s) (ht : Reachable s t)
    (hterm : Terminal t) : Cnt t = 1 := by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ Cnt t := reachable_cnt_ge_one ht hs
  have h2 : Cnt t ≤ 1 := (terminal_iff_cnt_le_one t).mp hterm

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

-- One legal blackboard move.
def BlackboardMove
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ),
    1 < m ∧
    1 < n ∧
    s = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest ∧
    t =
      Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ
      (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ
      rest

-- The board t can be obtained from s after zero or more moves.
def Reachable
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen BlackboardMove s t

-- No further legal move can be made from s.
def Terminal
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t

-- There is no infinite sequence of legal moves starting from s.
def TerminatesFrom
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s

lemma prod_move (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧
      t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod ∧
      t.prod ≤ s.prod ∧
      (0 < s.prod → (t.prod = s.prod ↔ Nat.gcd m n = 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hge1 : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := hgcdpos
  refine ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : t.prod * 1 ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := mul_le_mul_left' hge1 t.prod
    rw [mul_one] at hle
    calc t.prod ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := hle
      _ = s.prod := heq
  · intro hspos
    constructor
    · intro htst
      have h1 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
        have h0 := heq
        rw [htst] at h0
        exact h0
      have h2 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod * 1 := by rw [mul_one]; exact h1
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hspos h2
    · intro hg
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq

noncomputable def Cnt (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ := (s.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card

lemma cnt_cons_pos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = 1 + Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_pos (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h, Multiset.card_cons]
  omega

lemma cnt_cons_nonpos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : ¬ 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_neg (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h]

lemma cnt_cons_le (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) ≤ 1 + Cnt s := by
  by_cases h : 1 < a
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos s h]
  · rw [cnt_cons_nonpos s h]
    omega

lemma count_move_le (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Cnt t ≤ Cnt s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  subst hs
  subst ht
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have h1 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ rest)
  have h2 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) rest
  have ht_le : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) ≤ 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
    omega
  omega

lemma count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ)
    (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1) :
    Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) =
      Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) - 1 := by
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
    have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rw [hcop, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh
  have hmn : 1 < m * n := by
    nlinarith
  have ht_eq : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) = 1 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [hcop, hlcm]
    simp only [Nat.div_one]
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos (a := 1) (m * n ::ₘ rest) (by decide), cnt_cons_pos rest hmn]
  omega

noncomputable def Mu (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ := (s.prod, Cnt s)

def LtLex (p q : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := p.1 < q.1 ∨ (p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2 < q.2)

lemma move_decreases_measure (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) (hpos : 0 < s.prod) :
    LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := by
  show t.prod < s.prod ∨ (t.prod = s.prod ∧ Cnt t < Cnt s)
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  by_cases hg : Nat.gcd m n = 1
  · right
    have hst : t.prod = s.prod := by
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq
    refine ⟨hst, ?_⟩
    have hcnt := count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime rest m n hm hn hg
    rw [← ht] at hcnt
    have hCs : Cnt s = Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by rw [hs]
    have hpos2 : 0 < Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by
      rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm]
      omega
    rw [hCs, hcnt]
    omega
  · left
    have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
    have hgt1 : 1 < Nat.gcd m n := by omega
    have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
      · exfalso
        rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
        omega
      · exact h0
    have hlt : t.prod < t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgt1 htpos
      simpa using h2
    rw [heq] at hlt
    exact hlt

lemma lt_lex_wf : WellFounded LtLex := by
  have H : ∀ a : ℕ, ∀ b : ℕ, Acc LtLex (a, b) := by
    intro a
    have Ha : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) a := wellFounded_lt.apply a
    induction Ha with
    | intro a _ ih =>
      intro b
      have Hb : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) b := wellFounded_lt.apply b
      induction Hb with
      | intro b _ ihb =>
        apply Acc.intro
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := q
        have hq' : c < a ∨ (c = a ∧ d < b) := hq
        rcases hq' with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact ih c h1 d
        · rw [h1]
          exact ihb d h2
  exact ⟨fun p => H p.1 p.2⟩

lemma acc_pos_prod :
    ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, 0 < s.prod → Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
  have key : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, Mu s = p → 0 < s.prod →
      Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
    intro p
    have hacc : Acc LtLex p := lt_lex_wf.apply p
    induction hacc with
    | intro p _ ih =>
      intro s hMu hpos
      apply Acc.intro
      intro t ht
      have hlt : LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := move_decreases_measure s t ht hpos
      rw [hMu] at hlt
      have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
        obtain ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, hle, hiff⟩ := prod_move s t ht
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
          omega
        · exact h0
      exact ih (Mu t) hlt t rfl htpos
  intro s hpos
  exact key (Mu s) s rfl hpos

lemma exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two (t : Multiset ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ Cnt t) :
    ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ), 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧ t = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest := by
  unfold Cnt at h
  have hpos : 0 < (t.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card := by omega
  have hne : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha
  have hrcard : 1 ≤ r.card := by
    rw [hr, Multiset.card_cons] at h
    omega
  have hrne : r ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hrne
  obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem hb
  have ha1 : 1 < a := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hrle : r ≤ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact Multiset.le_cons_self r a
  have hb2 : b ∈ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := Multiset.mem_of_le hrle hb
  have hb1 : 1 < b := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hb2).2
  have hab : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' := by rw [hr, hr']
  have hle2 : a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' ≤ t := by
    rw [← hab]
    exact Multiset.filter_le _ t
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp hle2
  have hu2 : t = a ::ₘ (b ::ₘ r' + u) := by
    rw [hu, Multiset.cons_add]
  have hu3 : t = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ (r' + u) := by
    rw [hu2, Multiset.cons_add]
  exact ⟨r' + u, a, b, ha1, hb1, hu3⟩

lemma terminal_iff_cnt_le_one (t : Multiset ℕ) : Terminal t ↔ Cnt t ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hterm
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht⟩ := exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two t (by omega)
    exact hterm ⟨Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest, rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht, rfl⟩
  · intro hle
    rintro ⟨t', rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht, ht'eq⟩
    have hcnt : Cnt t = 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
      rw [ht, cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega

lemma cnt_ge_one_of_move {p q : Multiset ℕ} (h : BlackboardMove p q) : 1 ≤ Cnt q := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hp, hq⟩ := h
  subst hq
  by_cases hg : 1 < Nat.gcd m n
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hg]
    omega
  · have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hg1 : Nat.gcd m n = 1 := by omega
    have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
      have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
      rw [hg1, one_mul] at hh
      exact hh
    have hh1 : 1 < Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n := by
      rw [hg1, hlcm]
      simp only [Nat.div_one]
      nlinarith
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos _ hg, cnt_cons_pos _ hh1]
    omega

lemma reachable_cnt_ge_one {s t : Multiset ℕ} (h : Reachable s t) (hs : 1 ≤ Cnt s) :
    1 ≤ Cnt t := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hs
  | tail _ hbc _ => exact cnt_ge_one_of_move hbc

lemma nat_dvd_sub {k m n : ℕ} (h1 : k ∣ m) (h2 : k ∣ n) : k ∣ m - n := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2
  rcases le_total y x with hxy | hxy
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Nat.le.dest hxy  -- hz : y + z = x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    have hm : m = n + k * z := by
      rw [hx, hy, ← hz]
      ring
    omega
  · have hmn : m ≤ n := by
      rw [hx, hy]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hxy
    rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hmn]
    exact dvd_zero k

lemma gcd_min_max_sub (a b : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd a b = Nat.gcd (min a b) (max a b - min a b) := by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd a (b - a) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h2 h1
    have d2 : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a (b - a)
        have hb : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ a + (b - a) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at hb
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2
  · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd b (a - b) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h1 h2
    have d2 : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right b (a - b)
        have ha : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ b + (a - b) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at ha
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2

lemma factorization_gcd_eq_min (p m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hm' hn']
  simp [Finsupp.inf_apply]

lemma pow_dvd_of_not_dvd_of_dvd_mul {p a b k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) (hdvd : p ^ k ∣ a * b) : p ^ k ∣ b := by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime p a := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).mpr hpa
  have hcop' : Nat.Coprime (p ^ k) a := hcop.pow_left k
  exact hcop'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd

lemma factorization_mul_eq_add (p a b : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    (a * b).factorization p = a.factorization p + b.factorization p := by
  have ha' : a ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hb' : b ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_mul ha' hb']
  simp [Finsupp.add_apply]

lemma factorization_complement_min_zero (p m n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ m' n' : ℕ,
      m = Nat.gcd m n * m' ∧
      n = Nat.gcd m n * n' ∧
      m'.factorization p = m.factorization p - (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p ∧
      n'.factorization p = n.factorization p - (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p ∧
      min (m'.factorization p) (n'.factorization p) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_right m n
  have hgpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.gcd m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    · omega
  have hm'pos : 1 ≤ m' := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m' with h0 | h0
    · exfalso; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hm'; omega
    · omega
  have hn'pos : 1 ≤ n' := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n' with h0 | h0
    · exfalso; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hn'; omega
    · omega
  have hmul_m : m.factorization p = (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + m'.factorization p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hm']
    exact factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) m' hp hgpos hm'pos
  have hmul_n : n.factorization p = (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + n'.factorization p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hn']
    exact factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) n' hp hgpos hn'pos
  have hgmin : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n hm hn
  refine ⟨m', n', hm', hn', by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  rcases le_total (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) with hle | hle
  · have hgeq : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = m.factorization p := by
      rw [hgmin, min_eq_left hle]
    have hm'0 : m'.factorization p = 0 := by omega
    rw [hm'0]
    exact min_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _)
  · have hgeq : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = n.factorization p := by
      rw [hgmin, min_eq_right hle]
    have hn'0 : n'.factorization p = 0 := by omega
    rw [hn'0]
    exact min_eq_right (Nat.zero_le _)

noncomputable def Gp (p : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.gcd (s.map (fun x => x.factorization p))

lemma multiset_gcd_cons_nat (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Multiset.gcd (a ::ₘ s) = Nat.gcd a (Multiset.gcd s) := by
  rw [Multiset.gcd_cons]
  rfl

lemma Gp_eq_cons_cons (p : ℕ) (m n : ℕ) (rest : Multiset ℕ) :
    Gp p (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) =
      Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (Nat.gcd (n.factorization p) (Gp p rest)) := by
  unfold Gp
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons]
  rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat, multiset_gcd_cons_nat]

lemma factorization_lcm_eq_max (p m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p = max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_lcm hm' hn']
  simp [Finsupp.sup_apply]

lemma factorization_move_complement (p m n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p =
      max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
  have hmn : m * n ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hlcmpos : 1 ≤ Nat.lcm m n := by
    have hgl := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.lcm m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hgl
      exact hmn hgl.symm
    · omega
  have hhpos : 1 ≤ Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hcalc
      omega
    · omega
  have hfact : (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p =
      (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p := by
    have hstep := factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) hp hgcdpos hhpos
    rwa [hcalc] at hstep
  have hgc : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  have hlcm : (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p = max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_lcm_eq_max p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

lemma Gp_move_eq (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hst : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Gp p t = Gp p s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := hst
  subst hs
  subst ht
  rw [Gp_eq_cons_cons, Gp_eq_cons_cons]
  set R := Gp p rest with hR
  have hgc : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  have hgd : (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p =
      max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_move_complement p m n hp hm hn
  rw [hgc, hgd]
  calc
    Nat.gcd (min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))
        (Nat.gcd (max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)
            - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)) R)
        = Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd (min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))
            (max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)
              - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))) R :=
          (Nat.gcd_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)) R := by
          rw [← gcd_min_max_sub]
    _ = Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (Nat.gcd (n.factorization p) R) :=
          Nat.gcd_assoc _ _ _

lemma gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero : ∀ {u : Multiset ℕ}, (∀ y ∈ u, y = 0) → Multiset.gcd u = 0 := by
  intro u
  refine Multiset.induction_on u ?_ ?_
  · intro h; simp
  · intro a s ih h
    have ha : a = 0 := h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
    have hs : ∀ y ∈ s, y = 0 := fun y hy => h y (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy)
    rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat, ha, ih hs, Nat.gcd_zero_left]

lemma factorization_le_one_eq_zero {p x : ℕ} (h : x ≤ 1) : x.factorization p = 0 := by
  interval_cases x <;> simp [Nat.factorization_zero, Nat.factorization_one]

lemma Gp_eq_zero_of_forall_le_one {u : Multiset ℕ} (p : ℕ) (h : ∀ x ∈ u, x ≤ 1) :
    Gp p u = 0 := by
  unfold Gp
  apply gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
  rw [← hxy]
  exact factorization_le_one_eq_zero (h x hx)

lemma Gp_eq_val_of_singleton_filter {t : Multiset ℕ} (p : ℕ) {M : ℕ}
    (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    Gp p t = M.factorization p := by
  have hsplit : t = t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) + t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x) :=
    (Multiset.filter_add_not (fun x => 1 < x) t).symm
  have hrest : ∀ x ∈ t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x), x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx2 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    omega
  have hGprest : Gp p (t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x)) = 0 :=
    Gp_eq_zero_of_forall_le_one p hrest
  have ht_eq : t = M ::ₘ t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    rw [hM]
    simp
  rw [ht_eq]
  unfold Gp
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons]
  rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat]
  unfold Gp at hGprest
  rw [hGprest, Nat.gcd_zero_right]

lemma Gp_reachable_eq (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hst : Reachable s t) :
    Gp p t = Gp p s := by
  induction hst with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail h1 h2 ih =>
    rw [Gp_move_eq p hp h2, ih]

lemma factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ}
    (hst : Reachable s t) (hterm : Terminal t) {M : ℕ}
    (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    M.factorization p = Gp p s := by
  have hGpt : Gp p t = M.factorization p := Gp_eq_val_of_singleton_filter p hM
  have hGeq : Gp p t = Gp p s := Gp_reachable_eq p hp hst
  rw [← hGpt]
  exact hGeq

lemma eq_of_factorization_eq_all {a b : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → a.factorization p = b.factorization p) : a = b := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq (by omega) (by omega)
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p.Prime
  · exact h p hp
  · rw [(Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff a p).mpr (Or.inl hp),
        (Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff b p).mpr (Or.inl hp)]

lemma unique_M_eq {s t1 t2 : Multiset ℕ}
    (h1 : Reachable s t1) (hterm1 : Terminal t1)
    {M1 : ℕ} (hM1 : t1.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M1})
    (h2 : Reachable s t2) (hterm2 : Terminal t2)
    {M2 : ℕ} (hM2 : t2.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M2}) :
    M1 = M2 := by
  have hM1mem : M1 ∈ t1.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM1]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M1
  have hM1gt : 1 < M1 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hM1mem).2
  have hM2mem : M2 ∈ t2.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM2]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M2
  have hM2gt : 1 < M2 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hM2mem).2
  apply eq_of_factorization_eq_all (by omega) (by omega)
  intro p hp
  have e1 : M1.factorization p = Gp p s :=
    factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp h1 hterm1 hM1
  have e2 : M2.factorization p = Gp p s :=
    factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp h2 hterm2 hM2
  rw [e1, e2]

lemma exists_terminal_reachable : ∀ {s : Multiset ℕ}, Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s →
    ∃ t, Reachable s t ∧ Terminal t := by
  intro s h
  induction h with
  | intro s _ ih =>
    by_cases hex : ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
      obtain ⟨t', ht'1, ht'2⟩ := ih t ht
      exact ⟨t', Relation.ReflTransGen.head ht ht'1, ht'2⟩
    · exact ⟨s, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hex⟩

lemma cnt_terminal_eq_one {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hs : 1 ≤ Cnt s) (ht : Reachable s t)
    (hterm : Terminal t) : Cnt t = 1 := by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ Cnt t := reachable_cnt_ge_one ht hs
  have h2 : Cnt t ≤ 1 := (terminal_iff_cnt_le_one t).mp hterm
  omega

lemma Gp_eq_zero_of_not_dvd {p : ℕ} (_hp : p.Prime) (s : Multiset ℕ) (hnd : ¬ p ∣ s.prod) :
    Gp p s = 0 := by
  unfold Gp
  apply gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
  rw [← hxy]
  apply Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
  intro hpx
  exact hnd (hpx.trans (Multiset.dvd_prod hx))

noncomputable def M0 (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ p ∈ s.prod.primeFactors, p ^ (Gp p s)

lemma M0_pos (s : Multiset ℕ) : 0 < M0 s := by
  unfold M0
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hpp : p.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp).1
  exact pow_pos hpp.pos (Gp p s)

lemma factorization_M0 {s : Multiset ℕ} (hprod : s.prod ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (M0 s).factorization p = Gp p s := by
  unfold M0
  have hne : ∀ i ∈ s.prod.primeFactors, i ^ Gp i s ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hip : i.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hi).1
    exact pow_ne_zero (Gp i s) hip.pos.ne'
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ s.prod.primeFactors,
      (i ^ Gp i s).factorization p = if i = p then Gp i s else 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hip : i.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hi).1
    rw [Nat.factorization_pow, Finsupp.smul_apply, hip.factorization, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases h : i = p
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  rw [Nat.factorization_prod hne, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  by_cases hpS : p ∈ s.prod.primeFactors
  · rw [if_pos hpS]
  · rw [if_neg hpS]
    symm
    apply Gp_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hp s
    intro hdvd
    exact hpS (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hdvd, hprod⟩)

lemma M0_eq_of_terminal {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hprod : s.prod ≠ 0) (hst : Reachable s t)
    (hterm : Terminal t) {M : ℕ} (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    M = M0 s := by
  have hMmem : M ∈ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M
  have hMgt : 1 < M := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hMmem).2
  have hM0pos : 0 < M0 s := M0_pos s
  apply eq_of_factorization_eq_all (by omega) (by omega)
  intro p hp
  have e1 : M.factorization p = Gp p s := factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp hst hterm hM
  have e2 : (M0 s).factorization p = Gp p s := factorization_M0 hprod p hp
  rw [e1, e2]

theorem main
    (s : Multiset ℕ)

    -- Initially, there are exactly 2026 places on the board.
    (hcard : s.card = 2026)

    -- Every initial entry is greater than 1.
    (hlarge : ∀ x, x ∈ s → 1 < x) :

      -- Every sequence of legal moves is finite.
      TerminatesFrom s ∧

      -- At least one terminal board is reachable.
      (∃ t,
        Reachable s t ∧
        Terminal t) ∧

      -- Every reachable terminal board has exactly the same

      ∀ t,

  have hprod_pos : 0 < s.prod := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero

  have hterm : TerminatesFrom s := acc_pos_prod s hprod_pos

    have hfilter_eq : s.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = s := by

    fun t hst hterm' M hM p hp => factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp hst hterm' hM
  have hM_unique : ∀ t1 t2, Reachable s t1 → Terminal t1 → ∀ M1 : ℕ,
      t1.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M1} →
      Reachable s t2 → Terminal t2 → ∀ M2 : ℕ,
      t2.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M2} → M1 = M2 :=
    fun t1 t2 h1 hterm1 M1 hM1 h2 hterm2 M2 hM2 =>

  obtain ⟨t0, ht0_reach, ht0_term⟩ := exists_terminal_reachable hterm
  have hcnt_t0 : Cnt t0 = 1 := cnt_terminal_eq_one hcnt_s ht0_reach ht0_term
  have hcnt_all : ∀ t, Reachable s t → Terminal t → Cnt t = 1 :=
    fun t ht hterm' => cnt_terminal_eq_one hcnt_s ht hterm'
  have hM0_eq : ∀ t, Reachable s t → Terminal t → ∀ M : ℕ,
      t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M} → M = M0 s :=

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

-- One legal blackboard move.
def BlackboardMove
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ),
    1 < m ∧
    1 < n ∧
    s = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest ∧
    t =
      Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ
      (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ
      rest

-- The board t can be obtained from s after zero or more moves.
def Reachable
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen BlackboardMove s t

-- No further legal move can be made from s.
def Terminal
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t

-- There is no infinite sequence of legal moves starting from s.
def TerminatesFrom
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s

lemma prod_move (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧
      t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod ∧
      t.prod ≤ s.prod ∧
      (0 < s.prod → (t.prod = s.prod ↔ Nat.gcd m n = 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hge1 : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := hgcdpos
  refine ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : t.prod * 1 ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := mul_le_mul_left' hge1 t.prod
    rw [mul_one] at hle
    calc t.prod ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := hle
      _ = s.prod := heq
  · intro hspos
    constructor
    · intro htst
      have h1 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
        have h0 := heq
        rw [htst] at h0
        exact h0
      have h2 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod * 1 := by rw [mul_one]; exact h1
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hspos h2
    · intro hg
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq

noncomputable def Cnt (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ := (s.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card

lemma cnt_cons_pos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = 1 + Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_pos (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h, Multiset.card_cons]
  omega

lemma cnt_cons_nonpos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : ¬ 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_neg (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h]

lemma cnt_cons_le (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) ≤ 1 + Cnt s := by
  by_cases h : 1 < a
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos s h]
  · rw [cnt_cons_nonpos s h]
    omega

lemma count_move_le (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Cnt t ≤ Cnt s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  subst hs
  subst ht
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have h1 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ rest)
  have h2 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) rest
  have ht_le : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) ≤ 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
    omega
  omega

lemma count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ)
    (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1) :
    Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) =
      Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) - 1 := by
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
    have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rw [hcop, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh
  have hmn : 1 < m * n := by
    nlinarith
  have ht_eq : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) = 1 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [hcop, hlcm]
    simp only [Nat.div_one]
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos (a := 1) (m * n ::ₘ rest) (by decide), cnt_cons_pos rest hmn]
  omega

noncomputable def Mu (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ := (s.prod, Cnt s)

def LtLex (p q : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := p.1 < q.1 ∨ (p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2 < q.2)

lemma move_decreases_measure (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) (hpos : 0 < s.prod) :
    LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := by
  show t.prod < s.prod ∨ (t.prod = s.prod ∧ Cnt t < Cnt s)
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  by_cases hg : Nat.gcd m n = 1
  · right
    have hst : t.prod = s.prod := by
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq
    refine ⟨hst, ?_⟩
    have hcnt := count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime rest m n hm hn hg
    rw [← ht] at hcnt
    have hCs : Cnt s = Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by rw [hs]
    have hpos2 : 0 < Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by
      rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm]
      omega
    rw [hCs, hcnt]
    omega
  · left
    have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
    have hgt1 : 1 < Nat.gcd m n := by omega
    have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
      · exfalso
        rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
        omega
      · exact h0
    have hlt : t.prod < t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgt1 htpos
      simpa using h2
    rw [heq] at hlt
    exact hlt

lemma lt_lex_wf : WellFounded LtLex := by
  have H : ∀ a : ℕ, ∀ b : ℕ, Acc LtLex (a, b) := by
    intro a
    have Ha : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) a := wellFounded_lt.apply a
    induction Ha with
    | intro a _ ih =>
      intro b
      have Hb : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) b := wellFounded_lt.apply b
      induction Hb with
      | intro b _ ihb =>
        apply Acc.intro
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := q
        have hq' : c < a ∨ (c = a ∧ d < b) := hq
        rcases hq' with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact ih c h1 d
        · rw [h1]
          exact ihb d h2
  exact ⟨fun p => H p.1 p.2⟩

lemma acc_pos_prod :
    ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, 0 < s.prod → Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
  have key : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, Mu s = p → 0 < s.prod →
      Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
    intro p
    have hacc : Acc LtLex p := lt_lex_wf.apply p
    induction hacc with
    | intro p _ ih =>
      intro s hMu hpos
      apply Acc.intro
      intro t ht
      have hlt : LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := move_decreases_measure s t ht hpos
      rw [hMu] at hlt
      have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
        obtain ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, hle, hiff⟩ := prod_move s t ht
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
          omega
        · exact h0
      exact ih (Mu t) hlt t rfl htpos
  intro s hpos
  exact key (Mu s) s rfl hpos

lemma exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two (t : Multiset ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ Cnt t) :
    ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ), 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧ t = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest := by
  unfold Cnt at h
  have hpos : 0 < (t.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card := by omega
  have hne : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha
  have hrcard : 1 ≤ r.card := by
    rw [hr, Multiset.card_cons] at h
    omega
  have hrne : r ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hrne
  obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem hb
  have ha1 : 1 < a := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hrle : r ≤ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact Multiset.le_cons_self r a
  have hb2 : b ∈ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := Multiset.mem_of_le hrle hb
  have hb1 : 1 < b := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hb2).2
  have hab : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' := by rw [hr, hr']
  have hle2 : a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' ≤ t := by
    rw [← hab]
    exact Multiset.filter_le _ t
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp hle2
  have hu2 : t = a ::ₘ (b ::ₘ r' + u) := by
    rw [hu, Multiset.cons_add]
  have hu3 : t = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ (r' + u) := by
    rw [hu2, Multiset.cons_add]
  exact ⟨r' + u, a, b, ha1, hb1, hu3⟩

lemma terminal_iff_cnt_le_one (t : Multiset ℕ) : Terminal t ↔ Cnt t ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hterm
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht⟩ := exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two t (by omega)
    exact hterm ⟨Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest, rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht, rfl⟩
  · intro hle
    rintro ⟨t', rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht, ht'eq⟩
    have hcnt : Cnt t = 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
      rw [ht, cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega

lemma cnt_ge_one_of_move {p q : Multiset ℕ} (h : BlackboardMove p q) : 1 ≤ Cnt q := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hp, hq⟩ := h
  subst hq
  by_cases hg : 1 < Nat.gcd m n
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hg]
    omega
  · have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hg1 : Nat.gcd m n = 1 := by omega
    have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
      have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
      rw [hg1, one_mul] at hh
      exact hh
    have hh1 : 1 < Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n := by
      rw [hg1, hlcm]
      simp only [Nat.div_one]
      nlinarith
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos _ hg, cnt_cons_pos _ hh1]
    omega

lemma reachable_cnt_ge_one {s t : Multiset ℕ} (h : Reachable s t) (hs : 1 ≤ Cnt s) :
    1 ≤ Cnt t := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hs
  | tail _ hbc _ => exact cnt_ge_one_of_move hbc

lemma nat_dvd_sub {k m n : ℕ} (h1 : k ∣ m) (h2 : k ∣ n) : k ∣ m - n := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2
  rcases le_total y x with hxy | hxy
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Nat.le.dest hxy  -- hz : y + z = x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    have hm : m = n + k * z := by
      rw [hx, hy, ← hz]
      ring
    omega
  · have hmn : m ≤ n := by
      rw [hx, hy]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hxy
    rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hmn]
    exact dvd_zero k

lemma gcd_min_max_sub (a b : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd a b = Nat.gcd (min a b) (max a b - min a b) := by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd a (b - a) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h2 h1
    have d2 : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a (b - a)
        have hb : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ a + (b - a) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at hb
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2
  · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd b (a - b) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h1 h2
    have d2 : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right b (a - b)
        have ha : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ b + (a - b) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at ha
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2

lemma factorization_gcd_eq_min (p m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hm' hn']
  simp [Finsupp.inf_apply]

lemma pow_dvd_of_not_dvd_of_dvd_mul {p a b k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) (hdvd : p ^ k ∣ a * b) : p ^ k ∣ b := by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime p a := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).mpr hpa
  have hcop' : Nat.Coprime (p ^ k) a := hcop.pow_left k
  exact hcop'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd

lemma factorization_mul_eq_add (p a b : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    (a * b).factorization p = a.factorization p + b.factorization p := by
  have ha' : a ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hb' : b ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_mul ha' hb']
  simp [Finsupp.add_apply]

lemma factorization_complement_min_zero (p m n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ m' n' : ℕ,
      m = Nat.gcd m n * m' ∧
      n = Nat.gcd m n * n' ∧
      m'.factorization p = m.factorization p - (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p ∧
      n'.factorization p = n.factorization p - (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p ∧
      min (m'.factorization p) (n'.factorization p) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_right m n
  have hgpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.gcd m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    · omega
  have hm'pos : 1 ≤ m' := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m' with h0 | h0
    · exfalso; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hm'; omega
    · omega
  have hn'pos : 1 ≤ n' := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n' with h0 | h0
    · exfalso; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hn'; omega
    · omega
  have hmul_m : m.factorization p = (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + m'.factorization p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hm']
    exact factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) m' hp hgpos hm'pos
  have hmul_n : n.factorization p = (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + n'.factorization p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hn']
    exact factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) n' hp hgpos hn'pos
  have hgmin : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n hm hn
  refine ⟨m', n', hm', hn', by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  rcases le_total (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) with hle | hle
  · have hgeq : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = m.factorization p := by
      rw [hgmin, min_eq_left hle]
    have hm'0 : m'.factorization p = 0 := by omega
    rw [hm'0]
    exact min_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _)
  · have hgeq : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = n.factorization p := by
      rw [hgmin, min_eq_right hle]
    have hn'0 : n'.factorization p = 0 := by omega
    rw [hn'0]
    exact min_eq_right (Nat.zero_le _)

noncomputable def Gp (p : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.gcd (s.map (fun x => x.factorization p))

lemma multiset_gcd_cons_nat (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Multiset.gcd (a ::ₘ s) = Nat.gcd a (Multiset.gcd s) := by
  rw [Multiset.gcd_cons]
  rfl

lemma Gp_eq_cons_cons (p : ℕ) (m n : ℕ) (rest : Multiset ℕ) :
    Gp p (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) =
      Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (Nat.gcd (n.factorization p) (Gp p rest)) := by
  unfold Gp
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons]
  rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat, multiset_gcd_cons_nat]

lemma factorization_lcm_eq_max (p m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p = max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_lcm hm' hn']
  simp [Finsupp.sup_apply]

lemma factorization_move_complement (p m n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p =
      max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
  have hmn : m * n ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hlcmpos : 1 ≤ Nat.lcm m n := by
    have hgl := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.lcm m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hgl
      exact hmn hgl.symm
    · omega
  have hhpos : 1 ≤ Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hcalc
      omega
    · omega
  have hfact : (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p =
      (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p + (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p := by
    have hstep := factorization_mul_eq_add p (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) hp hgcdpos hhpos
    rwa [hcalc] at hstep
  have hgc : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  have hlcm : (Nat.lcm m n).factorization p = max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_lcm_eq_max p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

lemma Gp_move_eq (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hst : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Gp p t = Gp p s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := hst
  subst hs
  subst ht
  rw [Gp_eq_cons_cons, Gp_eq_cons_cons]
  set R := Gp p rest with hR
  have hgc : (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_gcd_eq_min p m n (by omega) (by omega)
  have hgd : (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n).factorization p =
      max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) :=
    factorization_move_complement p m n hp hm hn
  rw [hgc, hgd]
  calc
    Nat.gcd (min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))
        (Nat.gcd (max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)
            - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)) R)
        = Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd (min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))
            (max (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)
              - min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p))) R :=
          (Nat.gcd_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p)) R := by
          rw [← gcd_min_max_sub]
    _ = Nat.gcd (m.factorization p) (Nat.gcd (n.factorization p) R) :=
          Nat.gcd_assoc _ _ _

lemma gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero : ∀ {u : Multiset ℕ}, (∀ y ∈ u, y = 0) → Multiset.gcd u = 0 := by
  intro u
  refine Multiset.induction_on u ?_ ?_
  · intro h; simp
  · intro a s ih h
    have ha : a = 0 := h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
    have hs : ∀ y ∈ s, y = 0 := fun y hy => h y (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy)
    rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat, ha, ih hs, Nat.gcd_zero_left]

lemma factorization_le_one_eq_zero {p x : ℕ} (h : x ≤ 1) : x.factorization p = 0 := by
  interval_cases x <;> simp [Nat.factorization_zero, Nat.factorization_one]

lemma Gp_eq_zero_of_forall_le_one {u : Multiset ℕ} (p : ℕ) (h : ∀ x ∈ u, x ≤ 1) :
    Gp p u = 0 := by
  unfold Gp
  apply gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
  rw [← hxy]
  exact factorization_le_one_eq_zero (h x hx)

lemma Gp_eq_val_of_singleton_filter {t : Multiset ℕ} (p : ℕ) {M : ℕ}
    (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    Gp p t = M.factorization p := by
  have hsplit : t = t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) + t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x) :=
    (Multiset.filter_add_not (fun x => 1 < x) t).symm
  have hrest : ∀ x ∈ t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x), x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx2 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    omega
  have hGprest : Gp p (t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x)) = 0 :=
    Gp_eq_zero_of_forall_le_one p hrest
  have ht_eq : t = M ::ₘ t.filter (fun x => ¬ 1 < x) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    rw [hM]
    simp
  rw [ht_eq]
  unfold Gp
  simp only [Multiset.map_cons]
  rw [multiset_gcd_cons_nat]
  unfold Gp at hGprest
  rw [hGprest, Nat.gcd_zero_right]

lemma Gp_reachable_eq (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hst : Reachable s t) :
    Gp p t = Gp p s := by
  induction hst with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail h1 h2 ih =>
    rw [Gp_move_eq p hp h2, ih]

lemma factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) {s t : Multiset ℕ}
    (hst : Reachable s t) (hterm : Terminal t) {M : ℕ}
    (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    M.factorization p = Gp p s := by
  have hGpt : Gp p t = M.factorization p := Gp_eq_val_of_singleton_filter p hM
  have hGeq : Gp p t = Gp p s := Gp_reachable_eq p hp hst
  rw [← hGpt]
  exact hGeq

lemma eq_of_factorization_eq_all {a b : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → a.factorization p = b.factorization p) : a = b := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq (by omega) (by omega)
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p.Prime
  · exact h p hp
  · rw [(Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff a p).mpr (Or.inl hp),
        (Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff b p).mpr (Or.inl hp)]

lemma unique_M_eq {s t1 t2 : Multiset ℕ}
    (h1 : Reachable s t1) (hterm1 : Terminal t1)
    {M1 : ℕ} (hM1 : t1.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M1})
    (h2 : Reachable s t2) (hterm2 : Terminal t2)
    {M2 : ℕ} (hM2 : t2.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M2}) :
    M1 = M2 := by
  have hM1mem : M1 ∈ t1.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM1]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M1
  have hM1gt : 1 < M1 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hM1mem).2
  have hM2mem : M2 ∈ t2.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM2]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M2
  have hM2gt : 1 < M2 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hM2mem).2
  apply eq_of_factorization_eq_all (by omega) (by omega)
  intro p hp
  have e1 : M1.factorization p = Gp p s :=
    factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp h1 hterm1 hM1
  have e2 : M2.factorization p = Gp p s :=
    factorization_eq_Gp_of_terminal p hp h2 hterm2 hM2
  rw [e1, e2]

lemma exists_terminal_reachable : ∀ {s : Multiset ℕ}, Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s →
    ∃ t, Reachable s t ∧ Terminal t := by
  intro s h
  induction h with
  | intro s _ ih =>
    by_cases hex : ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
      obtain ⟨t', ht'1, ht'2⟩ := ih t ht
      exact ⟨t', Relation.ReflTransGen.head ht ht'1, ht'2⟩
    · exact ⟨s, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hex⟩

lemma cnt_terminal_eq_one {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hs : 1 ≤ Cnt s) (ht : Reachable s t)
    (hterm : Terminal t) : Cnt t = 1 := by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ Cnt t := reachable_cnt_ge_one ht hs
  have h2 : Cnt t ≤ 1 := (terminal_iff_cnt_le_one t).mp hterm
  omega

lemma Gp_eq_zero_of_not_dvd {p : ℕ} (_hp : p.Prime) (s : Multiset ℕ) (hnd : ¬ p ∣ s.prod) :
    Gp p s = 0 := by
  unfold Gp
  apply gcd_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
  rw [← hxy]
  apply Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
  intro hpx
  exact hnd (hpx.trans (Multiset.dvd_prod hx))

noncomputable def M0 (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ p ∈ s.prod.primeFactors, p ^ (Gp p s)

lemma M0_pos (s : Multiset ℕ) : 0 < M0 s := by
  unfold M0
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hpp : p.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp).1
  exact pow_pos hpp.pos (Gp p s)

lemma factorization_M0 {s : Multiset ℕ} (hprod : s.prod ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (M0 s).factorization p = Gp p s := by
  unfold M0
  have hne : ∀ i ∈ s.prod.primeFactors, i ^ Gp i s ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hip : i.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hi).1
    exact pow_ne_zero (Gp i s) hip.pos.ne'
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ s.prod.primeFactors,
      (i ^ Gp i s).factorization p = if i = p then Gp i s else 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hip : i.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hi).1
    rw [Nat.factorization_pow, Finsupp.smul_apply, hip.factorization, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases h : i = p
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  rw [Nat.factorization_prod hne, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  by_cases hpS : p ∈ s.prod.primeFactors
  · rw [if_pos hpS]
  · rw [if_neg hpS]
    symm
    apply Gp_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hp s
    intro hdvd
    exact hpS (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hdvd, hprod⟩)

lemma M0_eq_of_terminal {s t : Multiset ℕ} (hprod : s.prod ≠ 0) (hst : Reachable s t)
    (hterm : Terminal t) {M : ℕ} (hM : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = {M}) :
    M = M0 s := by
  have hMmem : M ∈ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hM]; exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self M

import Mathlib
import Aesop

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

-- One legal blackboard move.
def BlackboardMove
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ),
    1 < m ∧
    1 < n ∧
    s = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest ∧
    t =
      Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ
      (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ
      rest

-- The board t can be obtained from s after zero or more moves.
def Reachable
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen BlackboardMove s t

-- No further legal move can be made from s.
def Terminal
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t

-- There is no infinite sequence of legal moves starting from s.
def TerminatesFrom
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s

lemma prod_move (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧
      t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod ∧
      t.prod ≤ s.prod ∧
      (0 < s.prod → (t.prod = s.prod ↔ Nat.gcd m n = 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hge1 : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := hgcdpos
  refine ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : t.prod * 1 ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := mul_le_mul_left' hge1 t.prod
    rw [mul_one] at hle
    calc t.prod ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := hle
      _ = s.prod := heq
  · intro hspos
    constructor
    · intro htst
      have h1 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
        have h0 := heq
        rw [htst] at h0
        exact h0
      have h2 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod * 1 := by rw [mul_one]; exact h1
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hspos h2
    · intro hg
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq

noncomputable def Cnt (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ := (s.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card

lemma cnt_cons_pos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = 1 + Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_pos (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h, Multiset.card_cons]
  omega

lemma cnt_cons_nonpos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : ¬ 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_neg (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h]

lemma cnt_cons_le (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) ≤ 1 + Cnt s := by
  by_cases h : 1 < a
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos s h]
  · rw [cnt_cons_nonpos s h]
    omega

lemma count_move_le (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Cnt t ≤ Cnt s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  subst hs
  subst ht
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have h1 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ rest)
  have h2 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) rest
  have ht_le : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) ≤ 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
    omega
  omega

lemma count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ)
    (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1) :
    Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) =
      Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) - 1 := by
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
    have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rw [hcop, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh
  have hmn : 1 < m * n := by
    nlinarith
  have ht_eq : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) = 1 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [hcop, hlcm]
    simp only [Nat.div_one]
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos (a := 1) (m * n ::ₘ rest) (by decide), cnt_cons_pos rest hmn]
  omega

noncomputable def Mu (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ := (s.prod, Cnt s)

def LtLex (p q : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := p.1 < q.1 ∨ (p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2 < q.2)

lemma move_decreases_measure (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) (hpos : 0 < s.prod) :
    LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := by
  show t.prod < s.prod ∨ (t.prod = s.prod ∧ Cnt t < Cnt s)
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd

      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring

      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring

    have hst : t.prod = s.prod := by
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq

    refine ⟨hst, ?_⟩
    have hcnt := count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime rest m n hm hn hg

      omega
    rw [hCs, hcnt]
    omega

    have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
    have hgt1 : 1 < Nat.gcd m n := by omega
    have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
      · exfalso
        rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
        omega
      · exact h0
    have hlt : t.prod < t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgt1 htpos
      simpa using h2
    rw [heq] at hlt
    exact hlt

lemma lt_lex_wf : WellFounded LtLex := by
  have H : ∀ a : ℕ, ∀ b : ℕ, Acc LtLex (a, b) := by
    intro a
    have Ha : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) a := wellFounded_lt.apply a
    induction Ha with
    | intro a _ ih =>
      intro b
      have Hb : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) b := wellFounded_lt.apply b
      induction Hb with
      | intro b _ ihb =>
        apply Acc.intro
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := q
        have hq' : c < a ∨ (c = a ∧ d < b) := hq
        rcases hq' with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact ih c h1 d
        · rw [h1]
          exact ihb d h2
  exact ⟨fun p => H p.1 p.2⟩

lemma acc_pos_prod :
    ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, 0 < s.prod → Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
  have key : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, Mu s = p → 0 < s.prod →
      Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
    intro p
    have hacc : Acc LtLex p := lt_lex_wf.apply p
    induction hacc with
    | intro p _ ih =>
      intro s hMu hpos
      apply Acc.intro
      intro t ht
      have hlt : LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := move_decreases_measure s t ht hpos
      rw [hMu] at hlt
      have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
        obtain ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, hle, hiff⟩ := prod_move s t ht
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
          omega
        · exact h0
      exact ih (Mu t) hlt t rfl htpos
  intro s hpos
  exact key (Mu s) s rfl hpos

lemma exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two (t : Multiset ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ Cnt t) :
    ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ), 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧ t = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest := by

  have hpos : 0 < (t.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card := by omega
  have hne : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha

    rw [hr, Multiset.card_cons] at h

  have hrne : r ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp (by omega)

  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hp, hq⟩ := h

  · rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hg]

    have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by

      exact hh

    1 ≤ Cnt t := by
